support.faqQ1: How do I send a gift?
support.faqA1: Choose a gift card, pick an amount, add a message and pay. We'll deliver it by email, SMS or a shareable link.
support.faqQ2: Does the recipient need the app?
support.faqA2: No. They can open the gift link in a browser, view the card and redeem it. Creating an account is optional.
support.faqA3: Yes. Choose Schedule on the delivery step and pick the date you want it to arrive.
support.faqA4: Contact support within 14 days of purchase. Refunds are reviewed within 3–5 business days.
support.faqQ5: Where can I use a gift card?
support.faqA5: At the business shown on the card. Show the QR code at the counter when you pay.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.body:
By using Giftly you agree to these terms. Gift cards are issued by the participating business and are subject to their own terms. Giftly facilitates the sale and delivery of gift cards but is not the merchant of record for the underlying goods or services.

Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash. Lost or shared codes are the responsibility of the holder. We may update these terms from time to time and will post the latest version here.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
We collect the information needed to create your account, process payments and deliver gifts. We never store full card numbers or claim codes in plain text.

We share only the details needed to fulfil an order with the business and our payment provider. You can request a copy or deletion of your personal data from the profile settings.

about.title: About us
about.body:
Giftly is a marketplace for local gift cards. We help people send thoughtful gifts in seconds and help local businesses reach new customers.

Built with care for Qatar and the region.
